purpose: Developer operations surface combining live fleet diagnostics, Fleet API setup, infrastructure inspection, local utilities and documentation.
primaryGoal: Inspect and troubleshoot integration health, configure Fleet Telemetry and use developer tools without confusing missing or retained observations with healthy measurements.

dataSources.behavior: Independent fleet-wide snapshot, shared with telemetry tab; cancellation signal forwarded.
Overview inventory uses safeArray and inherited query policy. Local useVehicleOptions separately reimplements the same query without signal or equivalent normalization.
Telemetry tab has local optional VIN selection and independent read retries; POST refresh retrieves Tesla data. No request or mutation exercised.

All listed method/path pairs have source-confirmed routes. Helper catches rejected requests and resolves an error payload; component query policy therefore treats failures as success. Setup status queries poll every 30 seconds while Fleet API tab is mounted. No backend response shapes or operational permissions certified.

dataSources.hook: Bundled catalogs and local input processing
dataSources.behavior: Endpoint/signal/reference counts are explicitly catalog counts, not live coverage. Fifteen utilities consume local inputs. Tesla signal names are upstream identifiers, not physical-unit contracts. Onboarding completion persists under devtools-onboarding.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.use: Existing full-width layout, page actions, freshness and error boundary; query is metadata, not a whole-page loading gate.

components.name: TabNav / Button / Input / Textarea / Select / Accordion / Badge / GlassPanel / CopyButton / DataTable
components.use: Existing controls and tables; preserve table IDs, filters, pagination and mobile detail access.

components.name: OperationalBrief through AdminSummary
components.use: Existing useOperationalMetrics pipeline separates live counts from local catalog counts.

components.name: AlertBanner / StaleRefreshWarning / QueryError / Skeleton / EmptyState
components.use: Overview uses trust adapter; child tabs have uneven state handling.

components.name: FadeIn
components.use: Existing entry and tab transitions; implementation and reduced-motion runtime not exercised.

components.name: ToolCard / ResultPanel / TelemetryErrorsPanel
components.use: Page-domain presentation owners; reuse rather than introducing another tool-card/result renderer.

components.name: SignalConfigModal
components.use: Shared signal selection/interval overlay; caller inspected, overlay internals not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: useVehicleOptions reimplements the vehicle inventory query rather than adapting useVehicles, losing its cancellation/normalization/policy contract.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Adapt existing useVehicles to VIN options without changing query identities, source values or local selections.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Accordion already provides outer name/description/icon, while individual utilities render a nested ToolCard with the same name/description. This is repeated framing, not a reason to delete utility content.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse ToolCard or introduce a page-local embedded presentation option after preserving every utility input/result/action.

sourceObservations: Utilities stack then expand at md/lg/2xl/3xl; reference links use sm/lg grids; Fleet API uses lg two-column layout; infrastructure uses md/2xl grids.
TabNav has horizontal overflow containment, not a verified mobile interaction result.

issues.detail: Affected-count badge, selected VIN badge and refresh action share an unwrapped flex row. A long VIN/localized action can exceed a narrow tool card.
issues.fix: Allow wrapping/stacking and min-width containment while keeping VIN selection, clear and refresh reachable.

issues.detail: Long OpenSSL commands share a flex row with copy controls without explicit overflow or break handling; onboarding navigation at line 810 is also an unwrapped three-action row.
issues.fix: Contain command overflow independently and let navigation reflow; preserve complete copy payload and all three wizard actions.

issues.detail: Converted values always use five columns, including inside narrow utility cards; long numeric results have no explicit wrap strategy.
issues.fix: Use responsive result columns or bounded numeric overflow without dropping any of the five units.

sourceObservations: Refresh action has a localized accessible name; page tab icons are decorative; reference links have safe new-tab attributes and hidden new-tab hint.
TabNav intentionally implements a native-button pressed group, not an ARIA tablist. Do not impose tab roles without implementing the corresponding interaction model.

issues.detail: Upload PEM textarea has a nearby span but no label, explicit ID association or aria-label. CA certificate textarea at line 442 has the same pattern.
issues.fix: Pass localized label to existing Textarea, or explicit stable ID and matching label/description; preserve controlled values and PEM content.

issues.detail: TabNav has an ariaLabel API but this caller does not provide a group name. Outer section is named, which does not automatically name its nested group.
issues.fix: Pass existing localized developer-tool-area name through ariaLabel.

issues.detail: VIN clear button explicitly removes minimum height; VIN row action at line 45 also overrides height/padding. Source suggests undersized touch targets; actual geometry/spacing exceptions are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Retain native buttons and action names, restore reachable target sizing or demonstrate applicable spacing exception.

preservedStrengths: Overview adapts each query through useDataState, reports refresh failures separately and passes unknown flags instead of displaying fallback zero as a measurement.
Live and static catalog summaries remain independent; tabs are not gated on overview data.
TelemetryErrorsPanel distinguishes idle/loading/error/data/empty and retains unknown-shape raw disclosure and JSON download.

issues.detail: vinList defaults to [] and an always-rendered success badge reports 0 affected even while loading or on initial failure. isError branches at lines 145 and 191 replace retained tables during refresh failure.
issues.fix: Use existing per-source data-state adapter; display unknown until resolved and keep retained rows with stale warning plus independent retry.

issues.detail: apiFetch resolves request failures into {error}, so TanStack Query does not enter error/retry/retained-data states. Setup query error payloads replace previously valid configuration and onSuccess callbacks can run on failed writes; upload callback at FleetApiSection line 257 clears PEM input on such a failure.
issues.fix: Move reads/mutations into typed existing API hook ownership and preserve rejection/trust semantics. Audit all consumers before changing helper error shape; clear inputs/invalidate only on confirmed successful writes.

issues.detail: Changing local VIN does not reset or bind prior mutation responses. Config/error output and download filename use current VIN although retained payload may belong to an earlier VIN; vehicle-data tools at line 661 share this mismatch risk.
issues.fix: Associate results with submitted VIN, or reset affected results on selection changes; never relabel earlier observations as the current vehicle.

visualIssues.detail: Page-local icon color map uses neon background/text/ring for five hues across tool and reference cards. Wizard at FleetApiSection line 764 adds a neon cyan-to-green gradient; ResultPanel lines 45-46 uses neon result fills and fixed-white idle surface.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surfaces/borders and restrained semantic tokens; reserve hue for meaningful warning/failure/success rather than tool category decoration. Preserve explicit user palette preferences and all payloads.

visualIssues.detail: Domain tool headings/body use ad-hoc h3/p typography. Fleet API headings and specialist metadata repeat independent text-size/weight classes.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing PanelTitle/Text/Code roles with semantic as overrides, retaining heading hierarchy, identifiers and all explanations.

architectureIssues.detail: An 874-line feature file owns nine tool components, polling, mutations, request paths and presentation. apiFetch and useVehicleOptions also omit query cancellation.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract domain tools into single-purpose files and route typed data access through current API hooks; preserve mutation methods, payloads, polling, query keys and every tool.

architectureIssues.detail: SignalConfigModal is imported directly from the component implementation rather than the category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use an existing public export if available; otherwise request one centrally rather than editing shared exports from the page assignment.

architectureIssues.detail: Onboarding labels/descriptions are literal English rendered directly at FleetApiSection lines 791 and 804-806. describeCron/getRelativeTime also return English text rather than localized phrases.
architectureIssues.fix: Use canonical localization keys with fallbacks at presentation boundary; preserve onboarding IDs, persistence key and cron/timestamp calculations.

order: Repair child-source trust and VIN/result association before cosmetic adoption.
Fix field names and narrow-width action/result containment.
Subdue page-domain palette and unify typography without dropping tools.
Decompose Fleet API and reuse existing typed hook/query owners.

requiredSharedChanges.targetOwner: web\src\api\hooks\useAdmin.ts (existing domain candidate; file not inspected, API suitability unverified)
propsVariantsStates: Typed endpoint response contracts after backend verification
Preserve current write methods, request-client live-mode guard and no offline queueing
dependsOn: Audit helper consumers and backend response/error envelopes
Existing request/useDataState contracts; no new query engine

propsVariantsStates: No behavior or overlay API change; preserve open/onClose/categories/initialSelected/initialInterval/onSubmit

competingImplementations.name: Vehicle query duplication
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse typed hook; retain local VIN selector because header selection is intentionally disabled.

competingImplementations.name: Page-local neon category palette
competingImplementations.decision: Use existing tokens, not another semantic palette.

competingImplementations.name: Unused DevToolsOverview export
competingImplementations.evidence: devtools\index.ts:1; mounted page uses DevToolsBrief instead
competingImplementations.decision: Not mounted coverage; do not infer behavior from unused predecessor or delete it in this audit.

fleetApiTools: Fleet Telemetry subscription and signal configuration
Vehicle nearby charging/release notes/recent alerts/service data
actions: View/download telemetry errors and inspect unknown raw payload
Filter telemetry by VIN/clear/retry/refresh from Tesla
Search/open local utilities and perform their operations
DataTable filtering/mobile details/pagination and existing export affordances
dataBehavior: Keep tab query parameter tab with default fleet-api and five allowed values.
Keep devtools-onboarding localStorage key and seven stable step IDs.
Keep admin:fleet-health-vins, admin:fleet-health-errors and admin:fleet-api-errors table IDs.
Keep independent live-source trust and static catalog provenance.
Do not turn unknown into zero or clear retained measurements on refresh errors.
Preserve raw request/response payloads, catalog identifiers and SI values; no guessed conversion of upstream signal identifiers.
Keep 30-second setup status polling and existing query identities until deliberately reviewed.
Do not gate the whole page on a failed overview source.
Use current request-client live-mode and offline-write boundaries; no actual writes were tested.
preservation.workspace: workspaceScope.ts:23-76 does not register /dev-tools for global range; line 118 explicitly disables header vehicle selection. Keep fleet-wide inventory and required local VIN selectors. Adding a header range or deleting local selectors is not warranted.
preservation.sourceReadback: Root SHA256 unchanged at release preparation; no source files written.

evidenceLimits.method: Bounded read-only source audit; no Git, server, browser, production requests, source edits, queue writes or authentication bypass.
evidenceLimits.tests: NOT RUN; audit skill script read but not executed because it includes project-wide TypeScript, reserved for centralized validation. No lint/build/test executed.

scan.scope: Root page plus 29 non-test devtools source files, excluding summary/shared dependencies from scan counts
scan.note: Literal pattern matches, not exhaustive compliance. Initial case-insensitive raw-control count 62 included shared component names; corrected case-sensitive count is 0.

evidenceLimits.coverage: Full root page, five mounted tab owners, brief/summary, shared domain card/results/helpers inspected. Utility internals mostly inspected only through bounded pattern excerpts; CronParser and ByteSizeConverter read in detail. Shared primitives, SignalConfigModal internals, backend response implementations and i18n catalog completeness not fully audited.
noClaims: Route source registration is not mounted-route acceptance.
Existing tests were enumerated, not read as execution proof.
Preservation inventory is a source baseline, not complete runtime feature-parity certification.
